scripts.dev: if [ -f backend/app.py ]; then cd backend; elif [ ! -f app.py ]; then echo 'error: cannot locate backend/app.py' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; fi; exec "$PY" -m uvicorn app:app --host :: --port "${PORT:-5173}"
scripts.start: if [ -f backend/app.py ]; then cd backend; elif [ ! -f app.py ]; then echo 'error: cannot locate backend/app.py' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && PY=.venv/bin/python || PY=python3; fi; exec "$PY" -m uvicorn app:app --host :: --port "${PORT:-5173}"
scripts.seed: if [ -f sample_data/seed_demo_data.py ]; then S=sample_data/seed_demo_data.py; V=backend/.venv/bin/python; else S=../sample_data/seed_demo_data.py; V=.venv/bin/python; fi; if [ -x "$V" ]; then exec "$V" "$S"; else exec python3 "$S"; fi
scripts.test: if [ -f backend/smoke_test.py ]; then cd backend; fi; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python smoke_test.py; else exec python3 smoke_test.py; fi
